''Schitt's Creek'' (5) | website = {{URL|www.sagawards.org}} | image2 = | image2size = | alt2 = | caption2 = | previous = [[26th Screen Actors Guild Awards|26th]] | main = [[Screen Actors Guild Awards]] | next = [[28th Screen Actors Guild Awards|28th]] }} The 27th Annual [[Screen Actors Guild Awards]], honoring the best achievements in film and television performances for the year 2020, were presented on April 4, 2021. The ceremony was broadcast on both [[TNT (American TV network)|TNT]] and [[TBS (American TV channel)|TBS]] at 9:00 P.M. [[Eastern Time Zone|EST]] / 6:00 P.M. [[Pacific Time Zone|PST]], airing for one hour rather than the usual two.{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2021/04/sag-awards-winners-list-screen-actors-guild-1234727317/ |title=SAG Awards: 'The Trial Of The Chicago 7' Wins For Motion Picture Cast; 'The Crown', 'Schitt's Creek' Lead TV — The Complete Winners List |last1=Petski |last2=Hammond |first1=Denise |first2=Pete |date=April 4, 2021 |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |access-date=April 5, 2021}} The nominees were announced by [[Lily Collins]] and [[Daveed Diggs]] on February 4, 2021 via [[Instagram|Instagram Live]].{{cite web |url=https://www.sagawards.org/media/news/releases/nominations-announced-27th-annual-screen-actors-guild-awards |title=Nominations Announced for the 27th Annual Screen Actors Guild Awards |date=February 4, 2021 |publisher=[[Screen Actors Guild]] |access-date=February 4, 2021}}{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2021/02/2021-sag-awards-nominations-list-nominees-screen-actors-guild-1234686869/ |title=SAG Awards Nominations: 'Ma Rainey', 'Minari' Lead Film List; 'The Crown', 'Schitt's Creek' Top TV And 'Bridgerton' Arrives – Full List |last=Hipes |first=Patrick |date=February 4, 2021 |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |access-date=February 4, 2021}}{{cite web |url=https://www.sagawards.org/media/news/releases/lily-collins-and-daveed-diggs-announce-27th-annual-sag-awards®-nominations |title=Lily Collins and Daveed Diggs to Announce the 27th Annual SAG Awards® Nominations |date=January 28, 2021 |publisher=[[Screen Actors Guild]] |access-date=January 28, 2021}} Additionally, the shortened one-hour show was pre-recorded. The winners were informed of their wins a few days before the telecast and the acceptance speeches were also pre-taped. These changes were a [[COVID-19|COVID]]-era decision in order to protect the guild's nominees and presenters.{{cite web |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/minari-star-youn-yuh-jung-makes-history-at-sag-awards |title='Minari' Star Youn Yuh-jung Makes History at SAG Awards |last=Strause |first=Jackie |date=April 4, 2021 |work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |access-date=April 5, 2021}} [[Michael Keaton]] made history by becoming the first person in SAG history to win three awards for [[Screen Actors Guild Award for Outstanding Performance by a Cast in a Motion Picture|Outstanding Performance by a Cast in a Motion Picture]], winning this year for ''[[The Trial of the Chicago 7]]''. In 2015 and 2016, he was part of the winning ensembles for ''[[Birdman (film)|Birdman]]'' (2014) and ''[[Spotlight (film)|Spotlight]]'' (2015), respectively.{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2021/04/the-trial-of-the-chicago-7-sag-awards-frank-langella-aaron-sorkin-1234727497/ |title=SAG Awards: 'The Trial Of The Chicago 7' Wins Best Picture; Michael Keaton Sets SAG Record |last=Blyth |first=Antonia |date=April 4, 2021 |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |access-date=April 5, 2021}} [[Chadwick Boseman]] tied [[Jamie Foxx]] and [[Maggie Smith]] in the record for most nominations in a single ceremony with four: [[Screen Actors Guild Award for Outstanding Performance by a Male Actor in a Leading Role|Outstanding Performance by a Male Actor in a Leading Role]] for ''[[Ma Rainey's Black Bottom (film)|Ma Rainey's Black Bottom]]'', [[Screen Actors Guild Award for Outstanding Performance by a Male Actor in a Supporting Role|Outstanding Performance by a Male Actor in a Supporting Role]] for ''[[Da 5 Bloods]]'', and as part of the ensembles of both films for [[Screen Actors Guild Award for Outstanding Performance by a Cast in a Motion Picture|Outstanding Performance by a Cast in a Motion Picture]].{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2021/02/sag-nominations-chadwick-boseman-history-amy-adams-hillbilly-elegy-1234687358/ |title=SAG Nominations Movie Analysis: Chadwick Boseman's Record Showing, 'Minari's Strength And Strong Diversity Make Up For Globes Oversights |last=Hammond |first=Pete |date=February 4, 2021 |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |access-date=April 5, 2021}}{{cite web |url=https://www.goldderby.com/article/2021/sag-nominee-profile-chadwick-boseman-ma-raineys-black-bottom/ |title=SAG nominee profile: Chadwick Boseman ('Ma Rainey's Black Bottom') has set one record already this year |last=Stewart |first=Matthew |date=March 9, 2021 |publisher=[[Gold Derby]] |access-date=April 5, 2021}} Boseman ultimately won for Outstanding Performance by a Male Actor in a Leading Role, making history as the first actor to win the category posthumously; his widow, Taylor Simone Ledward, accepted the award.{{cite web |url=https://toofab.com/2021/04/05/chadwick-boseman-helps-make-history-at-sag-awards-with-posthumous-win/ |title=Chadwick Boseman Helps Make History at SAG Awards with Posthumous Win, Honored By Wife and Co-Stars |author=TooFab Staff |date=April 5, 2021 |publisher=TooFab |access-date=April 6, 2021}}{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2021/04/taylor-simone-ledward-chadwick-boseman-sag-award-1234727504/ |title=Taylor Simone Ledward Accepts SAG Award For Chadwick Boseman With Words Of Hope: "Be A Crusader" |last=Ramos |first=Dino-Ray |date=April 4, 2021 |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |access-date=April 6, 2021}} The ceremony also marked the first time that all four individual film acting categories were won by [[person of color|people of color]].{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2021/04/sag-awards-netflix-diversity-trial-of-the-chicago-7-1234727496/ |title=SAG Awards Analysis: A Big Night For Netflix, Diversity, And Possible Game Changer For 'The Trial Of The Chicago 7' |last=Hammond |first=Pete |date=April 4, 2021 |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |access-date=April 5, 2021}} ==Winners and nominees== * Note: Winners are listed first and highlighted in '''boldface'''.
